title: Smithsonian Adopts Policy on Ethical Returns (news release, 3 May 2022)
author: Smithsonian Institution

notes.text: This 3 May 2022 institutional news release describes adoption of the Smithsonian's ethical returns policy and its planned implementation across its museums. It is relevant to MoSA's study of museum return practices. The release is evidence of the announcement at that date, not a substitute for the current policy or evidence that a particular return occurred. No object identity is established. Full-page redistribution terms were not established during review, so no local capture is registered.
